m: अव-√ वा -वाति, to blow down, RV. x, 60, 11; (said of fire compared to a bull) to snort (i.e. to crackle) towards, RV. i, 58, 5.

s: puM, (ava + vad + GaY .) AjYA । nindA । viSvAsaH । iti medinI ॥ avaSaH, tri, (na vidyate vaSamAyattatvaM yasya .) avaSIBUtaH । vivaSaH । yaTA, -- “SlezmASru bAnDavErmuktaM preto BuNkte yato'vaSaH । ato na roditavyaYca kriyA kAryyA viDAnataH” ॥ iti SudDitattvaM ॥ (klIM, avaSyaM । niScitam .)
v: pu॰ ava + vada--GaY । 1 nindAyAm, 2 viSvAse, 3 avajYAyAm, 4 avalambane ca ।
m: अव-वाद m. speaking ill of, evil report, L.
a command, order, L.
trust, confidence, L.
instruction, teaching, Buddh.
a: अववादः — 1 Censure, reproach. --2 Trust, confidence. --3 Disregard, disrespect. --4 Support, dependence on. --5 Evil report. --6 A command, an order. --7 Information.

k.v: न्याय्यं च त्रिषु षट्संप्रधारणा तु समर्थनम्. अववादस्तु निर्देशो निदेशः शासनं च सः॥

m: अव-वादक m. a spiritual instructor, Divyāv.
अव-√ वी -वेति to eat, enjoy, RV. x, 23, 4.
अव-√ वद् (aor. Subj. 1. pl. -वादिष्म) to speak ill of or against (gen.), AitBr. (cf. दुर्-अववद.)

a: अववदः --वदनं — Censure, an evil report or reputation.

m: अव-वदन n. speaking ill of Sāy. on AitBr.
अव-वदित mfn. instructed, taught, Buddh.
अव-वदितृ m. one who speaks finally, who gives the definitive opinion, AitBr.
a: अववदितृ — a. 1 One who speaks finally or decisively. --2 An adjudicator.
अववरकः — 1 An aperture. --2 Window; see अपवरक.

m: अववर्ति aor. Ā. fr. √ वृत्, q.v.

v: na॰ ava + vfza--BAve lyuw । kftsnavarzaRe । “svapna nadItaraRAvavarzaRAmeDyadarSanaprayARezu tu sakftkAladravyEkArTatvAt” kAtyA॰ 1 । 7 । 13 । “taTA nadIM vfzwiYca kftsnAmevABisanDAya mantraM prayuNkte na cAvAntaranidrAM nApyekaM srotaH, nApyekAM varzaDArAm tasmAt sakftprayogaH tatra nadIsantaraRe srotasAM Bede'pi nadIdravyEkatvAt sakfnmantraH avavarzaRe kAlEkatvAdeva” karkaH ।
m: अव-वर्षण See अव-√ वृष्.
अव-वर्षण n. raining upon, KātyŚr.
अव-√ वृज् to disjoin, separate, Kāṭh. : Caus. (Pot. 3. pl. -वर्जयेयुः) to remove, TBr.
अव-√ वृष् (p. -वर्षत्) Ved. to rain upon, VS. xxii, 26, &c.
अव-वृष्ट mfn. rained upon, TBr.
अव-विद्ध See अव-√ व्यध्.
अव-विद्ध mfn. thrown down into (loc.), RV. i, 182, 6 and vii, 69, 7.
अव-विस्रंसित mfn. (√ स्रंस्, Caus.) fallen down, Bcar.
अव-√ व्रश्च् (Imper. 2. sg. -व्रिश्चा; impf. -अवृश्चत्) to splinter, cut off, RV. i, 51, 7 and vii, 18, 17.
a: अवव्रश्च् — {c6c} P. To splinter, to cut off.

m: अव-व्रश्च m. splinter, chip, ŚBr. xii.
अव-√ व्यध् -विध्यति, to throw down into (loc.), RV. ix, 73, 8, (opposed to अभ्या-रोहति Comm. = प्रमद्यति) to fall or sink down, TS.; (Pot. -विध्येत्) ‘to throw down from’, deprive of (loc.), TBr.
अव-√ व्ये (p. -व्ययत्) to pull off (as clothes), RV. iv, 13, 4.
